messages:
ana (CS): Heads-up 
-- Quasar launch Friday. Account flagged medium renewal risk; theyre doing a large conversation traffic test. We need a short customer-facing runbook (one page) that covers: prefill/poke, recommended batching levels by prompt size, streaming best-practices, quick smoke test, and a 2-question feedback ping for first 48h. Can someone own?

mike (CS): I can run this. Keep it short and include a link to our runbook repo. Also include a tiny FAQ for things customers often ask (e.g., why prefill matters).

dina (eng-runtime): Will provide the smoke test and expected metrics. My suggestions: prefill 15 short queries; verify KV hit rate >85% after warmup; run 40 streaming requests at ~100-200ms cadence and check 95th pct chunk latency <2s. If streaming chunk delay >2s, try non-stream mode and open a ticket.

sam-support: Add escalation steps: error rate threshold 1.5% over rolling 5m; median generation latency threshold 1.8s. If exceeded, contact support with trace_id. We'll auto-create an incident via feedback webhook if they submit the feedback form.

infra-bot: Reminder: Quasar dedicated pool provisioning scheduled Thu 22:00 UTC.

nana (CS): Small note: include a checkbox list for customers to confirm theyve completed prefill and smoke test. Also include a one-line "what we'll check" section so customers know we're monitoring KV priming, pool health, and recent deploys.

dina (eng-runtime): Shareable curl snippet (engineer note):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-small","input":"warmup","stream":true,"batch_size":16}'
```

Expected: HTTP 200, stream chunks starting <=1500ms, KV hit rate climbs >85% after 15 calls. If not, increase prefill_count to 30 or widen TTL to 60s.

mike (CS): I'll draft the customer wording: 3 bullets (Run prefill script; follow batching heuristic; perform smoke test). Short feedback form: Q1 "Were outputs satisfactory?" Q2 "If no, short details". Hook to feedback webhook.

nana (CS): Please also add a tiny "if you use async/queued calls" note: ensure your worker concurrency is >= batch_size to avoid queueing at the client side.

mike (CS): Good catch. Adding that. Ill finalize and post to #customer-success and DM Quasar CSM.
